summary: This Phase 3 clinical trial is testing the drug inclisiran in adults who were hospitalized for serious heart conditions known as acute coronary syndromes. Sponsored by Novartis Pharmaceuticals, the study has an enrollment of 305 participants and is currently active, not recruiting. Researchers are comparing inclisiran against a placebo, which is an inactive substance, when given alongside standard medical care. The main goal is to measure the percent change in LDL cholesterol levels from the start of the study to Day 150.
